**BLUF:** New Shahed/Geran drone waves launched toward Kyiv from multiple Russian oblasts, with at least one confirmed strike on a building in the city and reports of casualties; Ukrainian official tallies show sustained high-intensity fighting. Renewed clashes in Ethiopia’s Tigray and Amhara regions include TPLF advances, airport seizures, and internet restrictions, with UN warnings of civilian impact. Taiwan saw routine-low PLA activity (2 sorties, 1 ADIZ crossing). Yemen government forces struck Houthi positions and supply lines near Mocha/Dhubab/Taiz, with possible IRGC-linked casualties. No major shifts in other theatres.

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

- [HUMINT - CHATTER] @WW3_Monitor, @Ramos_Btc and @Maks_NAFO_FELLA (25 Sep ~14:44–15:28 UTC) reported new Shahed/Geran launches from Oryol, Kursk and Bryansk oblasts heading for Kyiv; one post included footage of a strike on a 5-story office building near the station with visible fire and smoke. Reach moderate among conflict-monitoring accounts; local media claims circulating but no widespread independent geolocation or confirmation of damage/casualties beyond the posts.[[1]](https://x.com/Maks_NAFO_FELLA/status/2103506853712011734)

- [OSINT - SOCIAL] @EthiopiaOnline, @kenyaaxis and others (25 Sep ~17:36–17:51 UTC) circulated reports of renewed fighting in Tigray/Amhara, TPLF airport seizures and advances, internet restrictions, and UN human-rights warnings on civilian strikes and deaths. Circulation moderate; organic from regional accounts with amplification in English-language outlets. No new closure attempt or major incident reported beyond the BBC-linked coverage.[[2]](https://x.com/kenyaaxis/status/2103542867650105344)

- [SIGINT - VERIFIED] @MoNDefense and @mna_roc (25 Sep ~01:00–01:03 UTC) reported 2 PLA aircraft sorties (1 crossing into eastern ADIZ), 6 PLAN vessels and 5 official ships around Taiwan. Low volume consistent with routine monitoring; no surge language.[[3]](https://x.com/mna_roc/status/2103289375421497365)

- [OSINT - SOCIAL] Yemeni and regional accounts (25 Sep ~16:08–17:53 UTC) shared footage and statements of Yemeni Armed Forces airstrikes on Houthi elements and supply lines in Dhubab, Mocha and Taiz areas; one account referenced possible IRGC-linked experts killed/missing after a strike. Circulation moderate; organic from Yemeni sources with some analyst amplification. No independent confirmation of IRGC deaths.

searched: Shahed Kyiv; Tigray fighting; Amhara Ethiopia; Taiwan PLA ADIZ; Houthi Mocha OR Dhubab; Novorossiysk drone OR strike

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Ukrainian General Staff via X/TG (25 Sep ~05:05 UTC) reported 236 combat engagements in the prior 24 hours, 1 missile + 80 airstrikes (296 guided bombs), 8,359 artillery rounds, and Ukrainian forces downing 1 missile + 80 Shahed-type UAVs. New Shahed waves toward Kyiv as detailed in Section 1. Front-line pressure sustained; no major confirmed territorial shifts in window.[[1]](https://x.com/Maks_NAFO_FELLA/status/2103506853712011734)

### MIDDLE EAST
- [OSINT - SOCIAL] Houthi and regional accounts continued circulation of Mocha/Dhubab consolidation footage and statements (as in Section 1); Saudi and international condemnations of Houthi threats noted in prior coverage. Quiet on Israel-Gaza/Lebanon/Syria/Iran nuclear in retrieved results.

### INDO-PACIFIC
- [SIGINT - VERIFIED] Taiwan MND reports (25 Sep) of 2 PLA sorties with 1 median-line/ADIZ crossing; consistent with prior patterns but below surge threshold. No new activity retrieved in South/East China Sea, Korea, Philippines or Japan posture.

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments retrieved.

### AFRICA
- [HUMINT - CHATTER] Reports of renewed Tigray/Amhara fighting and internet disruption (as in Section 1); aligns with GDELT hotspot but unconfirmed by multiple independent outlets beyond BBC and UN statements. Quiet on Sahel, Sudan, Libya, DRC, Nigeria.

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments retrieved.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments retrieved.

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
Quiet in window beyond Houthi/Bab al-Mandeb shipping concerns noted above. No new Novorossiysk incidents.

leads worked: 0 navigational warnings carried (none aligned with active theatres); 3 GDELT hotspots searched (Kyiv/Ukraine carried via official reporting; Ethiopia carried as chatter; Tigray/Amhara carried as chatter); 2 hotspots (Moscow, Washington) not substantiated as military events in retrieved sources.

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
- [OSINT - WEB] CISA added CVE-2026-67279 (MikroTik RouterOS) and CVE-2026-65660 (Microsoft SharePoint) to KEV on 25 Sep, confirming active exploitation.[[1]](https://x.com/Maks_NAFO_FELLA/status/2103506853712011734)

searched: CISA KEV; SharePoint vulnerability

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
- [OSINT - WEB] Supreme Court allowed Trump administration to use controversial voter-citizenship database for checks, despite warnings of erroneous flags on U.S. citizens.[[1]](https://x.com/Maks_NAFO_FELLA/status/2103506853712011734)

searched: Supreme Court voter database Trump

**FORECAST CHECK**  
1. TRIGGERED – New jet-powered Shahed waves launched toward Kyiv (Section 1 and Ukraine theatre).  
2. NOT TRIGGERED – No new Houthi missile/drone attack on shipping reported; instead Yemeni strikes on Houthi positions.  
3. NOT TRIGGERED – PLA activity remained low (2 sorties).  
4. NOT TRIGGERED – No Russian naval/air activity near NATO assets reported.

**INDICATORS AND WARNINGS**  
- Additional Shahed waves or ballistic strikes on Kyiv infrastructure in next 24–48h → Ukrainian AD strain or F-16 re-tasking → visible in Kyiv oblast reports or Air Force statements → likely.  
- Confirmed TPLF territorial gains or Eritrean involvement in Ethiopia fighting → regional escalation warnings from UN or IGAD → roughly even chance.  
- PLA sortie increase to >10 aircraft/24h with sustained median-line crossings → Taiwan MND escalation language → unlikely.  
- Houthi retaliation strike in Bab al-Mandeb or Red Sea → insurance spikes and naval response → first in Lloyd’s List or CENTCOM → roughly even chance.

**COLLECTION GAPS**  
- No independent confirmation of damage or casualties from latest Kyiv Shahed strike beyond local media claims.  
- Ethiopia fighting details (airport seizures, airport counts, exact front lines) rely heavily on partisan or single-source social reporting.  
- No primary-source verification of IRGC-linked casualties in Taiz strike.
